description_en: Retrieves network traffic monitoring data for accelerated domain names. Unit: byte
description_zh: 获取加速域名的网络流量监控数据，单位：byte
kebab_example: aliyun pcdn get-traffic-data --domain all --biz-region all --isp-name all --platform-type all --business-type all --start-date 2017-05-01 --end-date 2017-05-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrafficData

parameters.description_en: The domain names. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|). If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried.
parameters.description_zh: 域名，多个用竖线（|）分割，不传该参数查询全部。
